name: Discord Cache
description: Clears cached images and data from Discord.

name: Spotify Cache
description: Clears Spotify's local song/artwork cache. Music re-downloads on next play.

name: Steam Web Cache
description: Clears the cached HTML/JS the Steam client's built-in browser (store, friends list) keeps.

name: VS Code Cache
description: Clears VS Code's GPU/code cache. Rebuilt automatically on next launch.

name: Chrome Cache & Code Cache
description: Deeper pass than Smart Cleanup's own Browser Cache category -- also clears Chrome's compiled-script Code Cache.

name: Edge Cache & Code Cache
description: Deeper pass than Smart Cleanup's own Browser Cache category -- also clears Edge's compiled-script Code Cache.

name: Firefox Cache
description: Clears every Firefox profile's cache2 folder. Profile folder names are randomized by Firefox, so this matches all of them.

name: Memory Dumps
description: Removes crash dump files Windows writes after an application or system crash.

name: Windows Error Reporting
description: Clears queued and archived Windows Error Reporting crash reports.

name: DNS Cache
description: Flushes the Windows DNS resolver cache. Nothing to quarantine -- runs ipconfig /flushdns directly.

name: Thumbnail Cache (Deep)
description: Removes every cached thumbnail database file. A deeper pass than Smart Cleanup's own quick Thumbnail Cache category.
